source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 花园新手流程实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Sam (2026-09-09 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Sam
note: Sam(女性,wiki 提示语「Help her out?」),邻居家的年轻农场主,从父亲手里继承了农场却不擅长农活,所以拉着玩家一起经营花园。和玩家是熟络的朋友关系;说话朴素、热情、爱感叹(So exciting! / Amazing!!!),句尾常带省略号表示自己也不太懂机器的原理;不说网络黑话,不爆粗。私人岛屿上的开场台词在 Hub_General/NPC_Message/Sam.json,这里只放花园里的教程、温室教程和季节随机台词。
source_note: 实测采到 40 句,其余按社区 Wiki 补齐。变异作物那一段两家 Wiki 写法不同(minecraft.wiki 2026-09-09:并排种 2 份种子;fandom:用 4 株小麦围成十字),差异很大且都未实测,两种写法都保留。
新地块完成台词保留实测末尾一个感叹号和社区 Wiki 末尾两个感叹号的写法。
「Wow, you did it!」「Thank you so much!」「Come back with the right amount of items!」和别的 NPC 台词一字不差,按 README §4 用 ref 指向已有记录,避免同一渲染面两条同模板记录互相遮挡。

messages.context: 玩家第一次进花园
messages.raw: §fI am so excited to have you here!
messages.text: I am so excited to have you here!
messages.zh: 你能来我真是太开心了!

messages.raw: §fYou can come to me anytime you need help, but first let's clear out a plot to grow your crops.
messages.text: You can come to me anytime you need help, but first let's clear out a plot to grow your crops.
messages.zh: 需要帮忙随时来找我,不过咱们得先清出一块地来种庄稼。

messages.raw: §fFor that however... I need some Compost... If you can bring me some Wheat, I can make some Compost out of it!
messages.text: For that however... I need some Compost... If you can bring me some Wheat, I can make some Compost out of it!
messages.gloss: Compost → 堆肥、Composter → 堆肥器,沿用 Farming/TabList/Tab_List.json 的既定译名。
messages.zh: 不过要清地……得先有堆肥……你要是能给我弄些小麦来,我就能拿它做出堆肥!

messages.context: 交了 25 个小麦之后

messages.raw: §fNow I can finally produce some Compost... let's head inside!
messages.text: Now I can finally produce some Compost... let's head inside!
messages.zh: 这下总算能做堆肥了……咱们进屋去!

messages.context: 在堆肥器旁第一次对话
messages.raw: §fYou see this machine here...
messages.text: You see this machine here...
messages.zh: 你看这台机器……

messages.raw: §fIt produces Compost when you put crops inside of it... somehow... but that's what I need to increase the §f§lamount of plots §fwe can have! So exciting!
messages.text: It produces Compost when you put crops inside of it... somehow... but that's what I need to increase the amount of plots we can have! So exciting!
messages.gloss: 「amount of plots」在游戏里加粗,单独分一段。
messages.zh: 把庄稼丢进去,它就能产出堆肥……原理我也说不清……但有了堆肥,咱们能开的地块数量就能变多! 想想就激动!

segments.text: It produces Compost when you put crops inside of it... somehow... but that's what I need to increase the
segments.zh: 把庄稼丢进去,它就能产出堆肥……原理我也说不清……但有了堆肥,咱们能开的
就能变多! 想想就激动!

messages.raw: §fIt needs machine fuel to operate... luckily we can order fuel online!
messages.text: It needs machine fuel to operate... luckily we can order fuel online!
messages.gloss: Machine Fuel → 机器燃料(GLOSSARY 物品 Lore 固定词汇表)。
messages.zh: 它得靠机器燃料才能运转……好在燃料可以直接网购!

messages.raw: §fHead over to the desk, there you can browse SkyMart to order some fuel.
messages.text: Head over to the desk, there you can browse SkyMart to order some fuel.
messages.gloss: Desk → 管理台,沿用 Hub_General/GUI_Item/SkyBlock_Menu.json「花园管理台」;SkyMart 是自造商店品牌名,保留英文。
messages.zh: 去管理台那边,打开 SkyMart 就能下单买燃料。

messages.context: 还没在 SkyMart 买生物燃料时再次对话
messages.text: Remember, you can order fuel from the Desk nearby.
messages.zh: 记得,燃料可以在旁边的管理台下单。

messages.raw: §fGreat! Now, you can go open the composter and put the fuel in there, and it'll start doing... whatever it does!
messages.text: Great! Now, you can go open the composter and put the fuel in there, and it'll start doing... whatever it does!
messages.zh: 太好了! 现在去打开堆肥器,把燃料放进去,它就会开始……嗯,干它该干的事!

messages.context: 燃料还没放进堆肥器时再次对话
messages.text: Have you refuelled the Composter yet?
messages.zh: 你给堆肥器加燃料了吗?

messages.raw: Oh the Composter is done!
messages.text: Oh the Composter is done!
messages.zh: 哦,堆肥器做好了!

messages.raw: We can finally free up a plot! Take out the compost when you are ready!
messages.text: We can finally free up a plot! Take out the compost when you are ready!
messages.zh: 终于能腾出一块地了! 准备好了就把堆肥取出来吧!

messages.context: 买下第一块花园地块
messages.raw: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!
messages.text: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!
messages.zh: 太棒了!!! 咱们有一块崭新的地啦!

messages.raw: Now to the dirty part... the plot has to be cleaned up before it can be used...
messages.text: Now to the dirty part... the plot has to be cleaned up before it can be used...
messages.zh: 接下来是脏活……这块地得先清理干净才能用……

messages.raw: Head over to your unlocked plot and try to clean it up a bit and then come back to me once you've done so!
messages.text: Head over to your unlocked plot and try to clean it up a bit and then come back to me once you've done so!
messages.zh: 去你刚解锁的那块地,把它收拾收拾,弄完了再回来找我!

messages.context: 递出 Sam 的镰刀
messages.raw: Also, here take this.
messages.text: Also, here take this.
messages.zh: 对了,这个给你。

messages.context: 没领 Sam 的镰刀就再次对话
messages.text: Oh, I think you forgot to take this!
messages.zh: 哦,你好像忘了拿这个!

messages.raw: This Scythe will help you clean your plot even faster!
messages.text: This Scythe will help you clean your plot even faster!
messages.zh: 有了这把镰刀,清地能快不少!

messages.context: 合作档案里已有人买地但还没清理
messages.text: It looks like one of your co-op members already purchased a plot, but you should go help them clean it up!
messages.zh: 看来你的合作伙伴已经买下一块地了,不过你也该去搭把手,一起清理!

messages.raw: Great, you found it!
messages.text: Great, you found it!
messages.zh: 太好了,你找到了!

messages.raw: I believe in you. Go make it sparkly clean!
messages.text: I believe in you. Go make it sparkly clean!
messages.zh: 我相信你。去把它收拾得亮堂堂的!

messages.context: 清理完第一块地
messages.raw: Wow! It's squeaky clean over there, you did so well!
messages.text: Wow! It's squeaky clean over there, you did so well!
messages.zh: 哇! 那边收拾得一尘不染,你太厉害了!

messages.raw: Now you can grow crops you've unlocked there!
messages.text: Now you can grow crops you've unlocked there!
messages.zh: 现在你可以在那儿种已解锁的作物了!

messages.raw: To save you a bit of time, you can also use a preset farm at your desk!
messages.text: To save you a bit of time, you can also use a preset farm at your desk!
messages.gloss: preset → 预设,和 Desk 菜单里 Preset 的译名一致。
messages.zh: 想省点时间的话,也可以在管理台用预设农田!

messages.raw: Come and talk to me when you've finished up on your Plot!
messages.text: Come and talk to me when you've finished up on your Plot!
messages.zh: 你那块地忙完了就来找我聊聊!

messages.text: However, it looks like one of your co-op members already did that!
messages.zh: 不过,看起来你的合作伙伴已经把这事办好了!

messages.raw: I have an idea! Why don't you collect me some Wheat and I'll bake us some lovely bread for dinner!
messages.text: I have an idea! Why don't you collect me some Wheat and I'll bake us some lovely bread for dinner!
messages.zh: 我有个主意! 你去给我收点小麦,我来烤几块香喷喷的面包当晚饭!

messages.context: 玩家选了 [I'd rather not]
messages.raw: Pretty please...!!
messages.text: Pretty please...!!
messages.zh: 求你啦……!!

messages.raw: To bake us some bread, I think I need about 100 Wheat.
messages.text: To bake us some bread, I think I need about 100 Wheat.
messages.zh: 要烤面包的话,我估计得要 100 个小麦。

messages.raw: That shouldn't be a problem for someone like you, right?
messages.text: That shouldn't be a problem for someone like you, right?
messages.zh: 对你这样的人来说,不成问题吧?

messages.raw: Wow, that was quick! Here, take some fresh bread! *nom* *nom*
messages.text: Wow, that was quick! Here, take some fresh bread! *nom* *nom*
messages.gloss: *nom* 是嚼东西的拟声,中文用「吧唧」。
messages.zh: 哇,这么快! 来,尝尝刚出炉的面包! *吧唧* *吧唧*

messages.raw: It's pretty tasty. But it seems like we still have some dozen Wheat left over and our Composter is already full...
messages.text: It's pretty tasty. But it seems like we still have some dozen Wheat left over and our Composter is already full...
messages.zh: 真好吃。不过好像还剩下几十个小麦,而堆肥器已经装满了……

messages.raw: Oh, I have an idea! We could open a small stand and sell our Wheat to other people!
messages.text: Oh, I have an idea! We could open a small stand and sell our Wheat to other people!
messages.zh: 哦,我有主意了! 咱们可以支个小摊,把小麦卖给别人!

messages.context: 小麦没带够 100 个
玩家选了 [I'd rather keep it for myself]
messages.raw: Don't be selfish! This Wheat is too good to waste. We've got enough to share with everyone!
messages.text: Don't be selfish! This Wheat is too good to waste. We've got enough to share with everyone!
messages.zh: 别这么小气嘛! 这么好的小麦浪费了多可惜。咱们多得很,够分给大家的!

messages.raw: We need to set up a stand somewhere...
messages.text: We need to set up a stand somewhere...
messages.zh: 咱们得找个地方支摊子……

messages.context: 在访客摊位旁第一次对话
messages.raw: §fI think this spot would work perfectly!
messages.text: I think this spot would work perfectly!
messages.zh: 我看这个位置就再合适不过了!

messages.raw: Oh, we already have our first customer! How exciting, I wonder what they want! Can you check on them?
messages.text: Oh, we already have our first customer! How exciting, I wonder what they want! Can you check on them?
messages.zh: 哦,第一位顾客已经上门了! 好激动,不知道对方想要什么! 你去招呼一下?

messages.context: 还没接待第一位顾客时再次对话
messages.text: Your first customer is right in front of you!
messages.zh: 你的第一位顾客就在你眼前!

messages.text: Go ahead and talk to them to see what they need!
messages.zh: 去跟对方聊聊,看看需要什么!

messages.raw: Wow we did it! We served our first customer!
messages.text: Wow we did it! We served our first customer!
messages.zh: 哇,成功了! 咱们接待了第一位顾客!

messages.raw: Keep checking back on them, I am sure more people will visit our farm soon.
messages.text: Keep checking back on them, I am sure more people will visit our farm soon.
messages.zh: 记得常回来看看,我敢说很快就会有更多人来咱们农场的。

messages.raw: Besides that, you can always go check the desk to find out what to do next!
messages.text: Besides that, you can always go check the desk to find out what to do next!
messages.zh: 另外,不知道接下来做什么的话,随时可以去管理台看看!

messages.raw: I'll head back outside now.
messages.text: I'll head back outside now.
messages.zh: 那我先回外面去了。

messages.context: 从木匠那里领到温室设计图之后
messages.text: What's this? ... A blueprint for a Greenhouse?!
messages.zh: 这是什么? ……温室的设计图?!

messages.text: Do you know what this means??
messages.zh: 你知道这意味着什么吗??

messages.text: We can build our very own Greenhouse!
messages.zh: 咱们可以建一座属于自己的温室了!

messages.text: I'm so excited, I can't wait to get started on it!
messages.zh: 太激动了,我等不及要动工了!

messages.text: I'm sorry, I just can't help myself. Let me calm myself down a bit.
messages.zh: 抱歉,我实在按捺不住。让我先冷静一下。

messages.text: *deep breathing noises*
messages.zh: *深呼吸声*

messages.text: Alright, I feel better now. First we need to gather some resources to build the Greenhouse.
messages.zh: 好了,我缓过来了。首先,咱们得凑齐建温室的材料。

messages.text: Looking at the blueprint, it seems we need about 64 Enchanted Oak Logs and ...? 128 Enchanted Sand??
messages.zh: 照设计图看,大概需要 64 个附魔橡木原木,还有……? 128 个附魔沙子??

messages.text: If you can find these items, we'll be one step closer to building our very own Greenhouse!
messages.zh: 只要你能找齐这些东西,咱们离自己的温室就更近一步了!

messages.context: 温室还没建时再次对话
messages.text: Remember, you should go to the Desk and select one of your plots.
messages.zh: 记得去管理台,选一块你的地。

messages.text: Then, you should convert it to a Greenhouse.
messages.zh: 然后把它改建成温室。

messages.context: 在温室里第一次对话
messages.text: Wow, it looks even better than I imagined!
messages.zh: 哇,比我想象中还要漂亮!

messages.text: Now, let's get to work. It's time to plant our first crop.
messages.zh: 好了,开工吧。该种下咱们的第一株作物了。

messages.text: Why don't you do the honor? Here, take this carrot and plant it in the Greenhouse!
messages.zh: 这份荣誉就交给你了! 来,拿着这根胡萝卜,把它种进温室!

messages.text: Inside the Greenhouse, crops usually grow at a much slower speed than normal, but they will also yield way more!
messages.zh: 温室里的作物长得比平时慢得多,但产量也高得多!

messages.text: Nice! But crops need water to grow. Use this watering can to water the plot.
messages.zh: 不错! 但作物得浇水才能生长。用这把洒水壶给地块浇浇水。

messages.text: Watering a crop inside the Greenhouse is different than normal.
messages.zh: 在温室里浇水和平时不一样。

messages.text: In here, you need to water crops from time to time to keep them healthy.
messages.zh: 在这里,你得时不时浇一浇,作物才能长得健康。

messages.text: Otherwise they'll completely dry out!
messages.zh: 不然它们会彻底干枯的!

messages.text: Just aim the can at the crop you want to water and hold right-click!
messages.zh: 把洒水壶对准想浇的作物,按住右键就行!

messages.text: Look at that! It's already growing! It should be ready to harvest soon.
messages.zh: 快看! 它已经在长了! 应该很快就能收获。

messages.text: It's fully grown! You should be able to harvest it now.
messages.zh: 长熟了! 现在可以收获了。

messages.text: Amazing! We've done it! Our very first harvest from the Greenhouse. You've really got the hang of this.
messages.zh: 太棒了! 成功了! 温室里的第一次收成。你已经完全上手了。

messages.text: Now that you are familiar with the basics, let's move on to the more advanced techniques.
messages.zh: 基础你已经熟悉了,接下来讲点进阶的技巧。

messages.text: Planted crops in your Greenhouse apply buffs and debuffs to nearby crops!
messages.zh: 温室里种下的作物会给旁边的作物施加增益或减益!

messages.text: Let's visualize it to help.
messages.zh: 咱们直观地演示一下。

messages.text: Take these Carrot x2 and plant them next to each other in the Greenhouse.
messages.zh: 拿上这 2 根胡萝卜,把它们并排种进温室。

messages.text: And don't forget to water them!
messages.zh: 别忘了浇水!

messages.text: Remember, you need to plant 2 Wheat crops next to each other.
messages.gloss: Wiki 这一段前后自相矛盾(前面发的是胡萝卜,这里说小麦),照原文译,不替 Hypixel 改。
messages.zh: 记住,要把 2 株小麦并排种下。

messages.text: Then, water them so they grow strong and healthy.
messages.zh: 然后给它们浇水,让它们长得壮壮的。

messages.text: Once you do that, I'll show you a neat trick!
messages.zh: 弄好之后,我教你一个小妙招!

messages.text: Nice! Now that both plants are growing, take this Plant Diagnostics Tool to learn how crops are affected by each other.
messages.gloss: Plant Diagnostics Tool → 植物诊断工具,和 SkyMart 商品名一致。
messages.zh: 不错! 两株都在长了,拿上这个植物诊断工具,看看作物之间是怎么互相影响的。

messages.text: It's also great for knowing when a crop will finish growing or how much water it needs!
messages.zh: 它还能告诉你作物什么时候长熟、还需要多少水!

messages.text: Why don't you try it out right now?
messages.zh: 现在就试试吧?

messages.text: Try to use the Plant Diagnostics Tool on a crop to understand it better!
messages.zh: 对着作物用一下植物诊断工具,更好地了解它!

messages.text: Great job! I think you are ready to learn about mutations now!
messages.gloss: mutation → 变异作物,和 Common_Sidebar.json「扩散一株变异作物」一致。
messages.zh: 干得漂亮! 我看你可以学学变异作物了!

messages.text: Sometimes, when you grow certain crops next to each other, a mutation will eventually sprout nearby. This doesn't always need to be on dirt!
messages.zh: 有时候,把某些作物挨着种,附近就会冒出一株变异作物。而且它不一定非得长在泥土上!

messages.text: There are lots of mutations that exist and they are quite interesting to discover, however I really only know how to spread one of them.
messages.zh: 变异作物有很多种,一一发现它们很有意思,不过我只知道其中一种的培育方法。

messages.text: From what I remember, all you need to do is plant 2x Seeds side by side. Make sure to leave space for the mutation to spread!
messages.gloss: minecraft.wiki(2026-09-09)的写法;fandom 的旧写法见下一条,未实测,两条都留。
messages.zh: 我记得,只要把 2 份种子并排种下就行。记得留出空位,好让变异作物长出来!
messages.raw: §fFrom what I remember, all you need to do is plant §e2x Seeds §fside by side. Make sure to leave space for the §cmutation§f to spread!

segments.text: From what I remember, all you need to do is plant
side by side. Make sure to leave space for the
segments.zh: 并排种下就行。记得留出空位,好让

messages.text: From what I remember, all you need to do is surround an empty piece of farmland with 4x Wheat Crops, in a plus shape!
messages.zh: 我记得,只要用 4 株小麦把一格空耕地围成十字形就行!

messages.text: I have a few seeds left for you to try it out for yourself!
messages.zh: 我还剩几份种子,给你自己试试!

messages.text: Hmmmm I think that's right. I watered them too so they grow strong and healthy!
messages.zh: 嗯……我觉得这样就对了。我也给它们浇过水了,保准长得壮壮的!

messages.text: Wow, it worked!
messages.zh: 哇,成功了!

messages.text: Go ahead and harvest the mutated crop. Right there, in the middle of the wheat!
messages.zh: 去把那株变异作物收了吧。就在那儿,小麦中间!

messages.text: You are pretty much a Greenhouse Expert now!
messages.zh: 现在你差不多算温室专家了!

messages.text: I taught you all I know about Greenhouses, you are on your own from now on!
messages.zh: 关于温室我知道的都教给你了,接下来就靠你自己啦!

messages.text: If you have any more questions, you can talk to the Carpenter in the Greenhouse.
messages.zh: 还有什么问题的话,可以去温室里找木匠聊聊。

messages.context: 送出日晷之后
messages.text: Oh wow, is that gift for me?
messages.zh: 哇,这是送给我的礼物吗?

messages.context: 送出日晷之后

messages.text: I'll make sure to find a nice place for it!
messages.zh: 我一定给它找个好地方摆着!

messages.text: Looks like your HydroCan ran out of water, you can simply refill it by right-clicking on any water block! [I GET IT]
messages.gloss: HydroCan 是自造品牌名,保留英文;末尾方括号是可点的确认选项。
messages.zh: 看来你的 HydroCan 没水了,对着任意水方块右键就能加满! [我懂了]

messages.context: 教程做完后的随机台词
messages.text: When you paste a crop preset onto your Plot, it will plant any specified resource from your inventory. So cool!
messages.zh: 往地块上粘贴作物预设时,它会自动从你背包里取材料种下去。太酷了!

messages.text: As your Garden Level increases from working on the farm, you'll be able to harvest more crops. Amazing!
messages.zh: 在农场里忙活能提升花园等级,等级越高,能种的作物就越多。太棒了!

messages.raw: Make sure your composter has enough resources! It won't start making more compost if it doesn't have the full materials to do it.
messages.text: Make sure your composter has enough resources! It won't start making more compost if it doesn't have the full materials to do it.
messages.zh: 记得给堆肥器备足材料! 材料不够的话,它是不会开工做堆肥的。

messages.text: Oh, have you met my friends here? They like to host farming contests and sell cool new tools!
messages.zh: 哦,见过我这儿的朋友们了吗? 他们喜欢办农业竞赛,还卖各种新奇的工具!

messages.text: As you interact with more NPCs in the game, more kinds of customers will show up to buy stuff.
messages.zh: 你在游戏里接触的 NPC 越多,来买东西的顾客种类就越多。

messages.context: 空岛历一月到三月的随机台词
messages.text: I love spring! It's not too hot or too cold, it's perfect!
messages.zh: 我最爱春天了! 不冷不热,刚刚好!

messages.context: 空岛历四月到六月的随机台词
messages.raw: It's so warm outside!
messages.text: It's so warm outside!
messages.zh: 外面好暖和!

messages.raw: I should go out with my friends soon, maybe get some ice cream.
messages.text: I should go out with my friends soon, maybe get some ice cream.
messages.zh: 我该找朋友们出去玩玩了,顺便吃个冰淇淋。

messages.context: 空岛历七月到九月的随机台词
messages.text: The leaves are so colorful!
messages.zh: 树叶五颜六色的,真好看!

messages.context: 空岛历十月到十二月的随机台词
messages.text: It's cold out here!
messages.zh: 外面好冷!

messages.text: Make sure you're keeping yourself warm.
messages.zh: 记得注意保暖哦。

messages.context: 在别人的花园里和 Sam 对话
messages.text: Ah, hello there guest!
messages.zh: 啊,你好呀,客人!

messages.text: Meet me on your own island for help.
messages.zh: 想找我帮忙的话,回你自己的岛上来见我。

messages.context: 社区 Wiki 的双感叹号写法;实测单感叹号版本仍保留
messages.text: Amazing!!! We got ourselves a brand new plot!!
messages.zh: 太棒了!!! 咱们有一块崭新的地啦!
